items.headline: European Union Leaders Nominate Pablo Hernández de Cos as Next ECB President
items.summary: European Union leaders meeting in Brussels agreed to nominate former Bank of Spain governor Pablo Hernández de Cos to succeed Christine Lagarde as President of the European Central Bank. The selection occurred during an extraordinary EU summit focused on key leadership transitions, long-term budget negotiations, and financial support for Ukraine.

items.headline: US Regulators Approve SpaceX Plan to Deploy One Million AI Data Center Satellites
items.summary: The Federal Communications Commission has authorized SpaceX to launch up to one million satellites designed to operate as orbital data centers for artificial intelligence. This major regulatory decision enables the company to explore space-based computing to meet rising AI processing demands and reduce strain on terrestrial power grids.

items.headline: Philadelphia Eagles Stage Record 21-Point Thanksgiving Comeback to Defeat Dallas Cowboys
items.summary: On Thanksgiving Day, the Philadelphia Eagles staged a historic 21-point comeback to defeat their NFC East rival Dallas Cowboys 39-38. Quarterback Joe Milton III threw three touchdown passes before kicker Jake Elliott sealed the win with a 59-yard field goal with two seconds remaining, completing the largest comeback in NFL Thanksgiving history.

items.headline: "The Hunger Games: Sunrise on the Reaping" Dominates Thanksgiving Box Office
items.summary: Lionsgate's dystopian prequel "The Hunger Games: Sunrise on the Reaping" dominated the North American Thanksgiving box office after setting a franchise Tuesday record of nearly 16 million dollars. The film is on track to earn around 85 million dollars across the five-day holiday window, easily outperforming major new studio releases like Disney's animated film "Hexed".
